structured_output.what_is_happening: "Orvix Agent" is a pump.fun coin, 13 minutes old, trading at about $34k market cap on the bonding curve. It is one of at least 10 same-name "Orvix Agent" launches today. A different contract, Pj2Po…pump, was created about 5 minutes after this one and has already migrated to PumpSwap. It is at about $2.1M market cap with $132k liquidity and was up roughly +4,050% over the hour (DexScreener API). This coin looks like a copy or sympathy play riding that runner. Its creator has launched 25 tokens, and the best of them peaked at about $194k. The project website does not describe an AI compute network at all. It is a "Solana Dev Radar" dashboard with no contract address. There is also an unrelated real GitHub project, OrvixCompute (a GPU inference network whose token is "ORVX"), which may be the name source for the whole cluster.

narrative.description: The pitch is "Orvix Agent: decentralized AI computer network", an AI-agent/compute meme. The attention seems to be real and currently sits on the $2.1M Pj2Po contract.
narrative.why_spreading: One Orvix Agent contract ran from launch to about $2.1M within the hour. That set off a wave of copycat launches under the same name, and this is one of them.

token_connection.why_this_token: It launched about 5 minutes before the winner and lists the orvixagent X handle and a website, but the market has clearly picked Pj2Po as the canonical Orvix. This coin's volume looks like people buying the 'cheaper Orvix' after the winner ran. I could not check which contract the @orvixagent X account actually endorses (X returned 402).
token_connection.competing_tokens: Pj2Po1d29jqwZvkjPAMybiMJHDUWKzVcW8gLhJUpump ($2.1M market cap, $132k liquidity, migrated, the dominant one), plus about 8 other dead copies at ~$3k market cap, and 9jmUzo at $68k market cap with no liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: GeckoTerminal shows 287 unique buyers against 208 sellers. GMGN flags 23 bundler wallets, and the top rat-trader and entrapment trader percentages are both about 62%. The bot/degen rate is 58%. The top 10 holders all sit at a near-identical 1.44–1.48% each, which looks like a bundled distribution. There are no paid boosts. The creator is a serial launcher with 25 tokens.
authenticity.uncertainty: I had no X data, so I cannot tell whether the project account points to this contract.

structural_risks: Copycat of a $2.1M runner that has already migrated; sympathy demand usually fades
Uniform ~1.47% top-holder wallets suggest a bundle
Still on the bonding curve (95 of 115 virtual SOL), so holders can dump into the curve

structured_output.counterargument: This contract has the DexScreener profile, the X handle and the website. If @orvixagent endorses this contract rather than Pj2Po, it could be read as the 'real' one and re-rate sharply toward the winner's market cap. At $34k, a 2x only needs $68k, which a sympathy wave can easily reach. Its buy count is also healthy: 176 buys in the last 5 minutes.
unknowns: Which contract the @orvixagent X account endorses
Whether the Pj2Po runner is still climbing or already fading
Whether the bundler wallets are the dev's

source_coverage.notes: Web searches for the name and both contract addresses returned nothing relevant. The only related hit was an unrelated OrvixCompute GitHub project. x.com returned HTTP 402. I checked the DexScreener API for the competing token.

structured_output.thesis: This is a copycat of an Orvix Agent token that has already run to $2.1M. Its creator is a serial launcher, and its holder structure looks bundled. There is some sympathy volume and the market cap is low, so a 2x is not impossible, but the canonical attention is on another contract. That puts it below average for the pool.
